passages.note: Chaptered text page printing the operative section added by the bill; it names no voter.

rows.reasoning: Gipson voted Aye on the Assembly floor on SB 32 (2015-2016), a single-subject bill whose operative section requires that "statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the statewide greenhouse gas emissions limit no later than December 31, 2030". An emissions limit names no energy source and may be met by other means, so it does not establish "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines", nor any funding, permitting, neutrality or repeal clause. The vote shows only the pro-action side.
